Student sidebar links (Vazifalar/Avatarlar/Chat) therefore not verified from the UI in this run — only backend routes confirmed.

critical.issue: Returns 500 on the FIRST call of the day when no challenges exist yet. Root cause: after `await db.daily_challenges.insert_many(challenges)`, motor mutates the dicts to attach `_id: ObjectId`, then the function returns those same dicts. FastAPI cannot serialize ObjectId -> 'ValueError: ObjectId object is not iterable / vars() argument must have __dict__'. Subsequent calls succeed because the find() uses {"_id": 0} projection. Fix: pop `_id` from each challenge after insert_many, or re-fetch via find({date: today}, {"_id": 0}).

rca of the issue: GET /api/challenges/daily 500 RCA: When no challenges exist for today, the handler builds 3 dicts and calls `db.daily_challenges.insert_many(challenges)`. PyMongo/motor mutate each input dict in place to add `_id: ObjectId(...)`. The handler then loops over `challenges` to attach progress/completed and returns the list to FastAPI. FastAPI's JSON encoder cannot serialize ObjectId (it isn't iterable and has no __dict__), producing 'ValueError: [TypeError("ObjectId object is not iterable"), TypeError("vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute")]' -> 500. Fix: pop `_id` from each challenge dict after insert_many, e.g. `for c in challenges: c.pop('_id', None)`. Verified by re-running the same test after first call succeeded (find() with projection returns clean docs).
